description: Attach a phone number to an agent so the agent handles calls/SMS on that number. Takes an agent ID and a phone number ID. Returns the attached number and the agent it now belongs to.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that should own the number, from list_agents.

number_id.description: The ID of the number to attach, from list_numbers.

name: attach_number

outputSchema.description: The attachment result: the number and the agent it now belongs to.

agentId.description: ID of the agent the number was attached to.

title: Attach Number to Agent
